description: This file defines tracing categories, utility functions, and classes related to messaging and logging within the Thunder namespace. It includes category definitions for different log levels, and classes for representing method entry/exit, duration, and static text messages used in tracing.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a static text message for tracing, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a static text message for copying purposes in tracing.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents a static text message for assignment purposes in tracing.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a static text message for destructor tracing.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Represents a log entry for method entry, inherits from BaseCategoryType.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Represents a log entry for method exit, inherits from BaseCategoryType.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration log message, measuring elapsed time from a start time.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Utility function for formatting strings, with overloads for backward compatibility.
